name: Weisgram Metal Fab
old_description: We’re ready to help with your next project. Whether you need a quote, have questions about our services or want to discuss custom fabrication, our team is here to support you. Reach out by phone, email or through our contact form, and we’ll respond as soon as we can.
about:
Weisgram Metal Fab operates from West Fargo, North Dakota, where it has been run as a family-owned business for three generations. The company does not disclose its founding year, but its history is rooted in the values of hard work, accountability, and long-term relationships.

The shop provides end-to-end metal fabrication under one roof, including laser cutting, forming, machining, welding, finishing, powder coating, and quality control. It handles projects ranging from single prototypes to full-scale production runs, supported by advanced inspection equipment such as Virtek Laser QC systems, a Romer Arm, and a Leica laser tracker.

Weisgram serves customers in agriculture, automotive, construction, data centers, fitness, recreation, transportation, industrial equipment, and custom equipment building. The company works with steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, and offers engineering support through AutoCAD and SolidWorks to optimize designs for manufacturability.

The company emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certification, in-house process control, and investment in automation and training as differentiators that reduce touchpoints and improve repeatability from prototype to production.
